call_sites.usage: transient dedup key inside a collector run; never written to marts or CSV exports

existing_tests.name: snapshots and extracts contain no ssn/name/patientId
existing_tests.why: Assertions already forbid ssn/name/patientId in outputs; v3 dropping ssn/name is a no-op for those tests.

recommended_new_tests.name: pick() still returns four fields when the payload has given/family/identifier and no ssn
recommended_new_tests.fails_first_because: Today pick() reads record.patientId; a raw v3 payload without patientId returns null and trips the 0.5% guard. If identifier.value is mapped at the collector edge as the same dedup token, this test is the fail-first proof. Not a report-contract change — listed here so M4 can attach probe evidence.

gaps.deficiency: Missing-field guard is the only contract alarm and is keyed on patientId|gender|dob|address.zip. A rename of patientId to identifier would look like mass missing fields, which is loud — good — but is not labeled as a PIS contract change.
gaps.recommended_instrumentation: Keep the guard; add a run-level reason code 'projection_field_missing' (field names only, never values).

grade_reasoning: ssn and name are dropped at pick() today. Reports do not emit patientId. A collector-edge map from identifier.value onto the existing dedup token would be mechanical and does not change published numbers — classified unaffected, not a write candidate.

confidence.rationale: Projection is an explicit four-field pick. Residual uncertainty: whether M4 probe should still remap identifier.value inside pick() without calling that a migration.

evidence.quote: Explicit four-field pick — everything else dropped at projection (2022 privacy review).
patientId (carried only as a dedup key within the pull — it appears in no mart and no report)
